title: ProgramResourceViewDocument
description: Server-maintained, staff-readable label of one programme pickup point, hotel or function for the work shell: exactly the fields getProgramWorkAccess returns for it. The id is {programId}__{kind}__{resourceId}. Written by triggers on programPickupPoints, programHotels and programFunctions. A hotel's reception contact and notes, a function's venue notes, location, instructions and dress code, and a pickup point's coordinates and instructions are never copied. Which accounts read a view comes from their programAccessViews work lists; the communications duty also reads every function label, so photo albums carry function names. Never identity, permission or mutation authority.

active.description: Pickup points and hotels carry their own flag; functions are always active.

label.description: The pickup point label, the hotel name or the function name.

checkInEnabled.description: Functions only; true when the source omits it.

expectedCount.description: Functions only; 0 when the source has none.

checkedInCount.description: Functions only; 0 when the source has none.
